findings.desc: [codex-host-2, verified] Pass-bucket mutations can no-op and still 'conform'. For acceptanceBucket/acknowledgedLimitations classes (expected status:pass), tamper.mjs asserts verifyStatus==pass + fingerprintMatch against the frozen pass fingerprint, but does NOT assert the mutation actually CHANGED the corpus. If a malicious mutation silently no-ops (e.g. gold-weaken-expectedids finds no query with expectedIds.length>1), verify passes on the CLEAN corpus and the clean fingerprint equals the acknowledged-limitation pass fingerprint -> the harness emits conforming H2 blind-spot evidence for a tamper that was never applied. Fix: re-derive the byte-diff signal (records/gold/manifest changed vs clean) per class and assert the mutation genuinely applied (non-dropped classes MUST change the corpus), failing loudly on a no-op.

[codex-host-2, verified] dropped entries bypass the dropped-semantics check. For the dropped class (seed-swap[refreshed]) tamper.mjs records fingerprintMatch:null, takes disposition from the frozen bucket, and checks only verifyStatus==pass. If the mutation drifts to a no-op or another pass-producing change (e.g. gold-additive-field), it is silently mis-recorded as a valid dropped case. Fix: for dropped, assert the DEFINING property — records.jsonl AND gold-queries.json byte-identical to clean (only manifest metadata changed) — not merely verifyStatus==pass.

CHK-001:adversarial:0 (priority=should) has no bound verificationEvidence — validate reports status:missing for this intentRef. Independently confirmed the underlying claim is TRUE (27 unique iterationIds in tamper-verdicts.jsonl, each matching protocol.iterationIdRule format tamper/<scale>/<class>/<manifestHandling>; all 27 frozen tamperMatrix classes appear exactly once, 0 missing/0 extra/0 duplicates), but no verificationEvidence entry was ever recorded against CHK-001:adversarial:0 to bind that proof into the audit trail. Advisory (should-priority, not a must-gap): add a verificationEvidence entry for CHK-001:adversarial:0 citing this check so validate stops reporting it missing.
